ETH-base WORSE: HYPE (distinct cluster, large Sharpe drop), TRX (+5.0%/yr, vol_ratio=2.31x >= 2x but payment cycles align BTC not ETH). ETH-base BORDERLINE: AVAX (+4%/yr, corr=0.373 barely orthogonal, BTC wins). ETH-base BLOCKED: APT (-1.4%/yr, corr=0.966, same direction). ETH-base K670 SHIB: WORSE — BTC-BASE WINS, KEEP K595 (K632/K667-style) (ERC-20 NATIVE — inherent ETH cycle alignment test). NEW DISCRIMINATOR: ERC-20 native > vol_ratio > cycle alignment.
